label: Traffic Light
author: Conky-Studio
description: Three stacked lamps. Lights green / amber / red based on Value vs Warn / Danger thresholds.
lua_draw_body:
local cx = {x} + {radius}
 local r = {radius}
 local gap = {gap}
 local val = tonumber({value}) or 0
 local mode = 0 -- 0 green, 1 amber, 2 red
 if val >= {danger_at} then mode = 2
 elseif val >= {warn_at} then mode = 1 end
 local colors = {{color = {green}}, {color = {amber}}, {color = {red}}}
 -- unpack is awkward; draw three
 local function lamp(i, on_rgb, is_on)
  local cy = {y} + r + i * (2 * r + gap)
  local rr, gg, bb
  if is_on then rr, gg, bb = on_rgb[1], on_rgb[2], on_rgb[3]
  else rr, gg, bb = {off} end
  cairo_set_source_rgba(cr, rr, gg, bb, {opacity} * (is_on and 1 or 0.55))
  cairo_arc(cr, cx, cy, r, 0, 2 * math.pi)
  cairo_fill(cr)
  if is_on then
   cairo_set_source_rgba(cr, rr, gg, bb, {opacity} * 0.25)
   cairo_arc(cr, cx, cy, r * 1.55, 0, 2 * math.pi)
   cairo_fill(cr)
  end
 end
 local gr, gg, gb = {green}
 local ar, ag, ab = {amber}
 local rr, rg, rb = {red}
 lamp(0, {gr, gg, gb}, mode == 0)
 lamp(1, {ar, ag, ab}, mode == 1)
 lamp(2, {rr, rg, rb}, mode == 2)
